title: The Late Aftermath
author: Odile Ishikawa
blurb: Lena Okafor, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
